I can do that, but I need a quick confirmation on a few safe details before I touch your mailbox.

Please pick one of these actions (recommended = safest):

1) Recommended (safe): find all conversations with the Newsletters label older than 1 year (365 days), skip starred or unread items, show you a preview (up to 25 results) and then archive those conversations and remove the Newsletters label so they stop cluttering the label. Messages remain in All Mail (recoverable).

2) Remove-only (non-destructive): find those same conversations and just remove the Newsletters label (leave messages where they are). I will show a preview first.

3) Trash/delete (destructive): find conversations older than 1 year and move them to Trash (they will be permanently deleted after Gmail’s retention period). I will skip starred/unread by default unless you tell me otherwise and show a preview before doing it.

Other choices you may want me to apply before acting:
- Change the cutoff (exact date or N days instead of 365)
- Include starred/unread or conversations where some messages are newer
- Operate on entire conversations (default) or only individual messages

If you’re happy with the recommended plan, reply:
"Go ahead — recommended" 
(or pick “1”, “2”, or “3”, and mention any exceptions like “include starred” or a different cutoff date).

I’ll then show a preview of what would be affected and ask one last confirmation before making any destructive changes.
